### 🎯 Feature Concept & Clinical Objective
A clear and concise description of the feature and the clinical or usability benefit it provides to elderly dementia patients or family caregivers in Northeast India.

### 🧭 MoSCoW Priority Classification
- [ ] **Must Have** (Critical for Sept 5 Prototype or Sept 12 Grand Finale demo)
- [ ] **Should Have** (Important clinical or accessibility capability)
- [ ] **Could Have** (Desirable enhancement if time permits)
- [ ] **Won't Have (This Sprint)** (Deferred to post-hackathon Phase 2)

### 👥 Target User Persona
- [ ] Elderly Patient (Mild Cognitive Impairment / Early Dementia)
- [ ] Family Caregiver (Non-clinical surrogate)
- [ ] ASHA Worker / Primary Health Centre Nurse
- [ ] MDoNER Health Administrator / Researcher

### 📶 Offline Behavior Specification
Explain how this feature functions when the device has **zero internet connectivity**:
- What data is stored locally in SQLite?
- Does it require any background synchronization?
- How does the UI indicate offline status?

### 🎨 Proposed User Flow / Wireframe Sketch
Describe the screens, touch targets ($\ge 64\text{ dp}$), and audio prompts involved.
